provenance.label: HAND-AUTHORED. NOT A RECORDING.
provenance.note: Written by hand from the published KSeF OpenAPI contract. No request was ever sent to api-test.ksef.mf.gov.pl, or to any other host, to produce this file. The field names and types come from the contract; every value is invented.
invented: This response is deliberately self-contradictory and could not come from a healthy KSeF: the number embeds 20250826 but acquisitionDate falls on 2025-11-14, eighty days later. The gap is deliberately large: the client tolerates one day, because the number embeds the acceptance-for-processing date while acquisitionDate is the number-assignment instant and a session straddling midnight puts those on different days. It exists to prove the client treats a real disagreement as a hard error instead of trusting one date over the other.
Everything else is copied from invoice-metadata-200.json
